name: @penguinharness/computer-use
title: Computer Use
description: Computer use for PenguinHarness: Agents see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows and Linux through their accessibility trees, with agent-desktop.
descriptionZh: 让 Agent 用 penguin computer 看见并操作这台电脑上的桌面应用：经各操作系统的无障碍树（macOS、Windows 与 Linux）读取窗口、点击、输入、选择与等待，底层是 vercel-labs 的 agent-desktop。缺省只放行观察与语义操作；物理输入、剪贴板与通知读取由管理员开启，从不操作 PenguinHarness 自身。
shortDescription: See and operate desktop apps through their accessibility trees.
shortDescriptionZh: 经无障碍树查看并操作桌面应用。
